book.name: 1ª de Corintios
book.title: Yeets ner kuu mkee Paba lo re zha yez Corinto

content: Diiz Chul chaan Jesucrist kuu mke lo kruz
Re goo wetsʼn ne btan na, leettsa ngwatan kwent xkiiz Diox kuu wli lo re goo, mnit nay kon diiz kuu nagan neeka kon yalnzhaak chaan re men yezlyu ree.
Ne leettsa mndon lo re goo, nlaztʼn gagon na neeka thib kwent chaan goo, sinke thibka mndan kwent chaan Jesucrist kuu mke lo kruz lo goo.
Ne leettsa mzin na lo goo, neytʼn kwathoz nzhiitʼn ne nzebʼn,
ne leettsa mndan kwent xkiiz Diox lo goo, mnit nay kon yalnzhaak chaan re men yezlyu ree, neeka mtsowtʼn tsa yelaaz goo xkizʼn. Sinke lee Mbi Nayon ne yalney chaan Diox mtsow mloo re kuu thoz lo goo.
Ne nyelaaz goo Diox por yalney chaan Diox, nyelaazt goo Diox por yalnzhaak chaan re men yezlyu ree.
Mbi Nayon chaan Diox nloo naa cho nak Diox

Kona, kon yalnzhaak ndediz nee lo re zha kuu ney ndo nyelaaz Diox, per nagte kon yalnzhaak chaan men yezlyu ree, ne neeka nagte kon yalnzhaak chaan re zha kuu nabee lo yezlyu ree, tak reta koree telux.
Lee nee ndediz nee kon yalnzhaak chaan Diox, kuu ngoo gaats desde leettsa terka texkwaa Diox yezlyu, tsa taa Diox yalnaban kuu thitanax loʼaa.
Ne neeka thib re zha kuu mnabee lo yezlyu ree myent koree, tak os gayen zhay, gakeet zha Jesús Zha Nabee loʼaa lo kruz.

content.text: Re kuu neeka thib men ter wii,
ne re kuu neeka thib men ter gon,
ne re kuu neeka ter tsin leettsoo re men,
nak re kuu nap Diox par re zha kuu nke leettsoo Diox. [Is. 64:4]

content: Per lee Diox mloo re koree loʼaa por Mbi Nayon chaan Diox, tak lee Mbi Nayon nlebee reta kwaa, asta re xgab chaan Diox nlebee Mbi Nayon.
Wlipaa nin lo goo, neeka thib zha nlebeet xgab chaan tedib zha, sinke beeta xbi zha ne naa kwan nzo leettsoo zha. Ne leeka tata yent cho ne naa kwan ntsow Diox xgab, beeta Mbi Nayon chaan Diox ney.
Ne mkayaataa mbi yezlyu ree, leeʼaa mkayaa Mbi Nayon chaan Diox, tsa lebeeʼaa re kuu mndelaaz Diox loʼaa.

Kona ni nee re koree lo goo, kon yalnzhaak kuu nteed nee lo Mbi Nayon chaan Diox, ne nit neey kon yalnzhaak kuu mteed nee lo re men yezlyu ree, kona ndaa nee kwent chaan Diox lo re zha kuu nak zha Diox.
Lee re zha kuu nyelaazt Diox, napt zha Mbi Nayon chaan Diox leettsoo, ne nyent zha re kuu nak chaan Mbi Nayon, tak kuu naxen nake lo zha. Ne gagt yen zhay, tak napt zha Mbi Nayon chaan Diox.
Per lee zha kuu nap Mbi Nayon chaan Diox, nap zha yalnzhaak par yen zha reta kuu, ne yent cho tak tediz lee zha went nak.
Tak lo xkeets Diox nzhab: “¿Cho nlebee xgab chaan Diox? ¿Cho zha tak loo lo Diox?” [Is. 40:13] Per leeʼaa napaa xgab chaan Jesucrist.
